nodes.label: GARCH Volatility-Aware Regime Engine
nodes.rationale: GARCH(1,1) models time-varying conditional variance for volatility regime classification. Regime Classification: Low-Vol (forecast < 25th pctile), Normal (25th-75th), High-Vol (> 75th). Primary upgrade from current K-means.

nodes.label: CNN-LSTM Deep Learning Ensemble
nodes.rationale: Hybrid CNN-LSTM captures both spatial (feature relationships) and temporal dependencies. Pluggable alternative A to GARCH regime detector.

nodes.label: QED (Quantum Equilibrium-Disequilibrium) Model
nodes.rationale: Replaces GBM with metastable quartic potential. Models markets as open systems influenced by capital flows (RRP Drain Velocity, TGA Balance Change). Pluggable alternative B.

nodes.label: Event-Based Intrinsic Time
nodes.rationale: Event-based time provides parsimonious event-aware framework. Maps raw tick data into directional changes and overshoots. SurpriseIndicator uses entropy to calculate unlikeliness of price trajectories.

nodes.label: Climate-Liquidity Sensitivity Factor
nodes.rationale: As global energy mix shifts, normal RRP and TGA levels may shift requiring ILI threshold adjustments. Integrates multi-country trade model for energy shift dynamics.

nodes.label: Natural Disaster Exogenous Shock Detection
nodes.rationale: HFT algorithms react to earthquake early warning systems. Proactively flag ILI as DISLOCATED within 30 seconds of major disaster alert. New EXOGENOUS_SHOCK regime type.
